task: Remove background noise from a voice recording
packaging_note: Runs the upstream CPU executable for each architecture. FFmpeg converts the input to its required 48 kHz format.

inputs.what: a speech recording in a format FFmpeg reads

outputs.what: a denoised mono WAV file at 48 kHz

known_issues: Processes speech in mono. Music and already-clean recordings may not improve.
licence: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (source); the model is embedded in the upstream executable. Neither the executable nor its weights are redistributed in this image.

access.why: Downloads the official CPU executable with its embedded model from the upstream release on first use. The download container cannot read your recording.
